note: Shabbat Machar Chodesh is the Sabbath just before a New Moon. A special portion from the Prophets is read which says, “Tomorrow is the new moon...” (1 Samuel 20:18). This story also speaks about David’s empty seat. In Luke 1:26–33, an angel tells Miriam that her son, Yeshua, will receive the throne of David forever.
